Every string of the games is listed beside its English in `docs/strings-ja.md`. Every Japanese string is in the package's words, `src/strings.ts` (`KARAKURI_STRINGS.ja`), the stories' words, `src/storyWords.ts`, or the demo's table, `demo/demo.js` (`WORDS.ja`), beside its English.
